evidence.noLinkedForm: No feedback form is linked to this document.
evidence.title: Collected Feedback

lineage.absentReason: None of these documents records what it was built from — the usual answer for a hand-authored document, or one created before lineage was recorded. The row is still scorable; there is simply nothing to check the combination against.
lineage.acknowledgeFailed: This change could not be saved. Reload the page and try again.
lineage.acknowledgedNote: Marked as intentional, so this row does not show the generations warning.
lineage.acknowledgedReason: Someone marked this combination of document versions as intentional, so the row does not show the cross-generation warning. The warning comes back if the row’s documents change.
lineage.coherentReason: Nothing in this row crosses generations: no two documents are versions of the same type, and nothing recorded here points at a different generation of another document in this row. One ballot covers one generation of the idea.
lineage.repeatedTypeReason: This row holds more than one version of the same document type, so one ballot covers two generations at once. It is still scorable — add a row if you want a single generation on its own.
lineage.staleAction: This row is locked, so its documents and its ballots stay exactly as they are. Use {{action}} to score the fresher combination.
lineage.staleReason: A newer version of at least one document type on this row exists. The newest document of each type the row holds forms a combination in which none was built directly from an earlier version of another document in it, and nothing on the row is newer than that combination.
lineage.supersededSourceReason: One of these documents was built from a different generation of another document in this row, so the combination crosses generations. It is still scorable.

noteTooLong.description: Notes are limited to {{max, number}} characters, and a longer note is refused rather than shortened. Trim the note on the row you edited, then save again. Nothing has been saved yet.
noteTooLong.title: A note is too long to save

notes.label: Notes
notes.placeholder: Add notes about this prioritization decision...

rowAction.composeConflict: The row was not added to {{row}}'s project. Either the project already holds as many rows as it may, or its documents changed. Reload the page to see the current rows.
rowAction.composeFailed: The row was not added. Nothing was created, so you can try again.
rowAction.composeRefused: The row was not added, and the request was refused rather than failing: check what you picked — a row can hold only so many documents, and every one of them must still be in the project.
rowAction.deleteConflict: "{{row}}" was not deleted: it changed while it was being removed, or it is a project's only row and cannot be deleted. Reload the page to see the current rows.
rowAction.deleteFailed: "{{row}}" was not deleted. The row and its ballots are unchanged, so you can try again.
rowAction.deleteRefused: "{{row}}" was not deleted, and the request was refused rather than failing: the row may already be gone, or deleting a row together with its ballots may not be yours to do. Trying again will get the same answer.
rowAction.recomposeConflict: The documents on "{{row}}" were not changed: a ballot has already been cast, so its composition is locked. Add another row to score a different combination.
rowAction.recomposeFailed: The documents on "{{row}}" were not changed. Nothing was saved, so you can try again.
rowAction.recomposeRefused: The documents on "{{row}}" were not changed, and the request was refused rather than failing: check what you picked — a row can hold only so many documents, and every one of them must still be in the project.
rowAction.title: That change to the rows was not saved

rowDeleted.descriptionNoCount: "{{row}}" is gone, together with any ballots cast on it. No ballot count was reported.
rowDeleted.description_one: "{{row}}" is gone, and the one ballot cast on it went with it.
rowDeleted.description_other: "{{row}}" is gone, and the {{count, number}} ballots cast on it went with it.
